name: Barrow County — Hydrants
scope: Primarily Barrow County-owned utility hydrants; municipal systems are not comprehensively represented.
notes: Full audit: 1,639 records, 1,637 marked BARROW ownership and 2 null ownership; all Active. No missing geometry. Two coincident coordinate pairs retained because separate records are not proof of duplicate assets.
result_caution: Barrow county-owned utility mapping omits portions of municipal water systems. The nearest actual hydrant may be closer than this mapped result.

name: Monroe County — MGRC Fire Hydrants
scope: Monroe County regional-commission mapping; partial inventory, completeness not certified
notes: Published by MGRC GIS analyst Nicole Williams (nwilliams_MGRC). Sample geometry corresponds to coordinates rounded to 0.001 degrees (roughly 300–360 ft per degree-thousandth); position accuracy is unverified. No field observation date is exposed. Dataset extent includes points outside Monroe County. The old mgrcmaps.org EMS service was unresponsive; this is the separately published hosted layer.
result_caution: Monroe source positions may be coarse: the verified sample corresponds to coordinates rounded to 0.001 degrees. Treat distances as approximate and confirm hydrant position locally.

notes: Official public map layer. Same ID list and extent as WaterResourcesSewer/15; integrate only one copy. Excludes explicit Abandoned, Does Not Exist and Model codes. Unknown statuses may remain; enabled network membership is not interpreted as hydrant operation.
result_caution: Fulton county water-system mapping primarily serves North Fulton. Municipal completeness and hydrant operation are not certified.
status_filter_label: Explicit Abandoned, Does Not Exist and Model records excluded; other published statuses retained.

name: City of Atlanta — In-service Water Hydrants
scope: Atlanta water-system published hydrants labeled IN SERVICE, including portions outside city limits; partial inventory.
notes: Government-domain current OpMap/assets layer replaces an unavailable historical WaterDistributionTst service. Excludes OUT OF SERVICE, null and other status codes. Source inventory has no exposed field-survey currency.
result_caution: Atlanta source status is a published label, not a current field inspection. Some municipal/private systems may be missing.
status_filter_label: Published In Service records only. Out-of-service and unknown status records excluded.

name: Forsyth County — Existing Water Hydrants
scope: Official public water hydrants labeled Existing (Active); partial inventory, not certified countywide completeness.
notes: Government GIS/Water Department publisher. Explicitly excludes removed, inactive, abandoned, construction and other lifecycle codes. Public schema does not expose a per-record update timestamp.
result_caution: Only published Existing/Active records are searched; that label does not certify operational status or access.
status_filter_label: Published Existing/Active hydrants only. Removed, inactive, abandoned and construction records excluded.

name: City of Smyrna — Fire Hydrants
scope: Smyrna municipal water mapping only; partial Cobb coverage. Countywide and other municipal inventories are not integrated.
notes: Official city article links staff-created SMYGIS app 33d02249b29c48c7b2db0242b7aa3465. Its ArcGIS owner Smyrna_GA also owns Water Database item 76a9393d49fd4eae920eb1c759e5366f. Public hydrant point layer is in Smyrna, Georgia. No status definition is assumed from free-text fields.
result_caution: Cobb coverage includes Smyrna only. Other Cobb municipal and county utility inventories may contain closer hydrants. Source records are not proof of operation.
